body:
PXD024809 provides nominal-dose standards in a serially diluted JY HLA-eluate matrix. Aligned quantities, scored candidates and the transition library use distinct identifiers and missingness states; aligned quantities alone cannot be treated as detected concentrations.

Add `write_dilution_observer_package`, `verify_dilution_observer_package` and 15 relations through the existing EvidenceStore. The revision pins 17 originals and preserves all literal cells, large IDs, exact form/charge/target library membership, feature links/comparisons, the complete standard panel, nominal levels and source-qualified material/protocol claims. Version **2.0.40**, source head **1b3ad56**.

DIA1/DIA2 have different reported windows and are not assumed exchangeable replicates. Missing library standards are not negatives. Nominal solution amounts are not certified on-column amounts; the dilution conflict and unknown recovery/actual-parameter claims remain explicit. This is a source package, not an admitted calibration recipe or a model of intracellular abundance.

Validation:
- Format/lint pass with all 340 files unchanged. The full default local suite passes **3,571 tests** in 379.80 s; the exact-head gate and byte-restorable full log are retained in the [canonical report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/d614b8ce8b1e917cfe8211280de61e0a13366282/experiments/2026-10-25_0959_codex_dilution-canonical/README.md). The default local suite excludes integration.
- Hosted workflow **40183613623** passes Python 3.10–3.14 units, lint, integration and combined coverage; docs build **40183613700** passes.
- Canonical build attempt 3 passes in **80.89 s / 1.70 GiB peak RSS**. Independent replay attempt 1 passes in **83.24 s / 2.23 GiB peak RSS**. Both retain the unchanged 20-minute/3-GiB/disk guards.
- Independent original-source checks reconcile **17 originals**, **1,031,853 tabular rows**, **29,039,248 literal cells**, **297,876 numeric comparisons**, all 15 table counts and metadata/material relationships. Public queries pass after independent reconciliation.
- All **57 closure artifacts** verify against published Git bytes. Frozen executable/configuration snapshots are unchanged; the two earlier build preflight refusals remain archived. Full-source tampering was not separately tested; existing small fixtures cover rejection after rehash.
- Source-package review checks non-overwriting independent snapshots, full typed replay, versioned family routing and exact public relationship cardinalities. No outstanding review threads or submitted reviews were present at the pre-merge check.

Ready for source merge. Tested PyPI publication remains required; nominal-dose training admission and biological transfer remain separate next steps.

Refs #845.
